description.en: A restrained opening sequence where typography is revealed through light, scale, and structure.
description.zh: 用光线、尺度与结构，让文字在克制的开场序列中逐步显现。

prompt: Create a 15-second cinematic title sequence for the exact title “AFTER THE SIGNAL.” Spell the title exactly and do not add any other copy. Begin inside a vast brutalist concrete corridor at dawn. A narrow band of light moves across the walls and reveals fragments of the letters as if they are cut into the architecture. The camera advances on a perfectly straight track while the corridor proportions slowly become impossible: walls separate, stairs rotate ninety degrees, and the title fragments align in perspective. At 11 seconds, the camera reaches an open chamber where the complete title stands as a physical structure. Hold the final readable composition for three seconds. Use cool grey concrete, one red signal light, volumetric haze, realistic scale, and restrained sound-reactive pulses. No people, shaky camera, fantasy ornament, misspelled text, subtitles, or watermark.
